demo.headline: Bounded shock, no fear
demo.caption: An Erdos-Renyi network: 300 banks, about 4 links each, links thrown down at random. Two banks fail (a = r = 2). With fear switched off a bank fails only once 2 of its own neighbours have failed - one more bank goes, and the chain runs out.
